rows.grounds: locative plural of sahasra, expressing quantity
locative plural compound denoting loci of birth or embodiment
past passive participle describing beings subjected to suffering

items.question: In what vast number and kind of loci are beings subjected to torment?
premises: These womb-mechanisms number eighty-four thousand (caturaśīti sahasreṣu).
items.inference: Beings undergo torment throughout the full expanse of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The compound yoniyantra may be rendered as womb-mechanisms, matrices of birth, or sources of embodiment.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
